Akash Network selects Solana for blockchain migration Akash Network said it has selected Solana as the destination for its planned blockchain migration. The decentralized GPU and AI compute network currently runs its own Cosmos SDK-based chain, but previously said it intends to move to a shared-security architecture to reduce network maintenance costs and the capital burden associated with AKT staking. Solana and Ethereum had both been under consideration before Akash made its final choice. — link

CZ Attends Nasdaq Bell-Ringing Ceremony for World's Largest Corporate BNB Treasury Firm Nasdaq-listed BNB Standard Corporation (NASDAQ: BNC) rang the opening bell at Nasdaq's MarketSite in Times Square, New York, to mark its rebranding and the appointment of Alex Odagiu as CEO. Formerly known as CEA Industries, the company officially changed its name on September 29. Its business includes managing a corporate BNB treasury, and it plans to operate a validator node on BNB Chain. The company claims to hold the world's largest corporate BNB treasury. — link

Jack Dorsey's Bitcoin-Enabled Bitchat Tops France's App Store Social Chart Jack Dorsey's decentralized messaging app Bitchat topped France's App Store Social Networking chart following nationwide protests and an Orange network outage on October 21. The app enables offline messaging via Bluetooth mesh networks, supports Nostr-based communication, and integrates Bitcoin-backed Cashu eCash payments. — link

Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Hoodi Fork Over EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 Risks Ethereum researcher Toni Wahrstätter said the planned Glamsterdam fork on the Hoodi testnet has been delayed after ChainSecurity identified compatibility risks in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038. The gas changes could break contracts that assume gas usage only decreases or cause failed sub-calls to behave unexpectedly. ChainSecurity has found 13 real-world cases, and developers are reviewing whether the upgrade specification needs changes. — link
